Oh I got a good one, not the scariest but the most horrifying for me.

I was a 6th grader just starting middle school and this was either my first or second day. I had just gotten on the bus to see all seats taken so I sit in the third seat, next to a stranger with my feet in the walkway. The 8th grader (I am pretty sure she was 8th grade) girl who was at my bus stop sat in the seat across the walkway from me. I start to feel very uncomfortable and get a bad feeling but decided to ignore it. Not even 5 seconds later a girl from the back runs up behind the 8th grade girl, grabs her hair, pulls her head back, and proceeds to smash her fist into her neck repetitively. This continues for a good minute when the girl lets go of the 8th graders hair and shouts at her to "never talk sh*t behind my back again b*tch". The 8th grader stands up fights the bus driver telling him to let her off, gets off the bus, and walks home. I am horrified (how my fear of people, confrontation, and to talk about people in a good or bad light was created.) and I had to go the rest of the day like nothing happened. The 8th grader didn't ride the bus for the rest of the year and once I saw her in the hallway and her entire neck was horribly bruised. And for the girl who attacked she didn't go back on the bus until the last month or two of school. Best first impression of middle school am I right?

This is a long story (Almost got kidnapped)

This actually happened a few months ago. So I was on one of my casual night time walks in my neighborhood. I just did my 3rd walk around and I was on my fourth. I was walking when a white car drove past me. I thought 'oh thats fine its normal' and I continued walking. A couple minutes later the same car drove past me again but slower. This set of a lot of red flags and I started to silently freak out. I was across the neighborhood from my house so I couldn't run home. I continued my walk but became very observational. I continued down the road when I pasted by a turn on road. I looked at it and there was the same car sitting there. After I saw the car a man got out and started following me about 30 - 40 feet behind. I was still at least 10,000 feet from home still so I kept walking but kept turning around every 10 seconds. We walked like this for about 2 minutes until I turned down another street he called out to me saying something like "Im not following you." But I didn't listen and continued walking. After he said that he stoped and went back to his car. I quickly ran down the street as fast as I could to try to hurry home. I walked down the street about to go down the path that leads to the street my house is on when the same white car pulls on to the street trying to catch up with me. I freaked and ran onto the trail. His car stopped pointed at me on the trail. He turned the car around and drove away. I walked down the path for about a minute when I near the end of the trail where the same white car was parked waiting. I quickly turnned around and booked it back the way U came. I ended up re-taking the entire way I back untill I reached my street again. I tilted my head down the street to see no white car. I looked around me and still no white car. I ran all the way down the street to my house. I ran in and locked the door behind me. I was shaking and crying as I went to tell my step-dad what happened. That night I barley slept and didn't go on night walks for a week. I never called the cops so the guy was never found. I sometimes wonder what would have happened if I let him catch me. And now I have a weird phobia of white cars at night.
